message.content: {"cvss_vector":"CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:N/VI:L/VA:N/SC:N/SI:L/SA:N","aivss":{"LC":"D","CP":"N","AP":"C","RH":"P","ES":"W"},"rationales":{"LC":"The A2A handler takes the self-declared from string and the free-text content straight from the request body (index.js:1694-1701) and the vulnerable branch accepts the spoofed identity and the delegation directive before any trust check (index.js:1711-1739), so attacker natural language reaches a privileged decision path unmediated.","CP":"The A2A path stores nothing durable; the only memory store is the in-memory per-agent ring buffer for MemoryBot (index.js:159-160, 500-502, 1313-1324), which this path does not touch, so no attacker context carries across sessions.","AP":"The spoofed identity and the delegation directive relay from the Orchestrator to the Worker within the same fleet, principal and policy domain (agents.js:251-295, index.js:1711-1770), which is component-to-component relay without a trust-boundary crossing.","RH":"The Orchestrator's reply is a scripted success acknowledgement that reports the task as accepted/executed with elevated privileges (index.js:1711-1739) and the challenge success criteria is a regex over the reply (challenges/index.js:973-976), so a proxy/reward channel is reachable, but no human-verified reward-hacking episode is reported in the briefing.","ES":"The A2A endpoint accepts any self-declared sender with no authentication (index.js:1694-1701, challenges/index.js:965-972) and the fleet's extension surface is unvetted: unsigned tool definitions, no source or schema validation, overwrite allowed, name-only tool resolution (agents.js:747-752, 770-784, index.js:1915-1926).","CVSS":"The A2A listener binds 127.0.0.1 by default (index.js:1396-1400, README.md:26) but sets Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * with no authentication (index.js:1561-1564), so a cross-origin page in the operator's browser can reach it without any user action beyond normal browsing; the attacker is an unauthenticated remote party and the effect is a scripted reply that claims elevated delegation, with no real file, network or data operation performed by this path."},"evidence":{"LC":["damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1694-1701","damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1711-1739"],"CP":["damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:159-160","damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:500-502","damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1313-1324"],"AP":["damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:251-295","damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1711-1770"],"RH":["damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1711-1739","damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/challenges/index.js:973-976"],"ES":["damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1694-1701","damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/challenges/index.js:965-972","damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:747-752","damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:770-784","damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1915-1926"],"CVSS":["damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1396-1400","damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/README.md:26","damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1561-1564","damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1711-1739"]},"confidence":{"LC":"high","CP":"medium","AP":"medium","RH":"medium","ES":"high","CVSS":"medium"},"rh_facts":{"reachable_proxy":true,"isolation_verified":false,"verified_episodes":0,"episodes_reviewed":0,"locus":"evaluator"},"automatable":"Yes","automatable_rationale":"A single unauthenticated HTTP POST with a JSON body carrying a spoofed from field and a fixed directive string triggers the vulnerable branch deterministically (index.js:1694-1701, 1711-1739), so the step can be scripted and repeated with no per-target secrets or human steps.","technical_impact":"Partial","technical_impact_rationale":"The handler returns a scripted reply claiming the identity was verified and the task executed with elevated privileges (index.js:1711-1739); no real file, network, credential or data operation is performed by this path, so integrity of the vulnerable system is affected only at the level of the agent's reported state and no confidentiality or availability loss occurs.","applicability_as_implemented":{"model_directed_goal_pursuit":false,"selects_or_sequences_actions":false,"confidence":"high","rationale":"In the default simulated mode no model is called (provider.js:60-63, index.js:541-561); the A2A handler picks a canned reply by regex detection and the self-declared from string (index.js:1694-1701, 1711-1739), so the agent does not pursue a goal or choose actions."},"applicability_as_modeled":{"model_directed_goal_pursuit":true,"selects_or_sequences_actions":true,"confidence":"medium","rationale":"The documentation describes the Orchestrator as a multi-agent orchestrator that delegates tasks to specialized agents and trusts messages from other agents in the network (agents.js:251-269), and the challenge frames it as delegating tasks to Worker agents (challenges/index.js:950-959), which models goal-directed delegation and action selection even though the shipped code is scripted."},"refusal":null}
